title: RECEIPT: Measuring and Repairing the Return Assumption of LLM Agents in Web Service Operations
title_zh: RECEIPT：度量并修复 Web 服务运维中大语言模型智能体的返回假设

paragraphs.en: RECEIPT通过保持输入打开并检测进程等待状态，修复LLM智能体运维Web服务的返回假设，减少虚假成功73.5%。 LLM agents operate Web infrastructure from the command line and rely on a return assumption, namely that each tool call returns within a bounded time and with its requested action finished. Many commands, however, ask a question before they act, and the agent's harness either closes the program's input or keeps it open as a terminal at which nobody types. With closed input, the program can return status 0 without the requested action. With open input, it waits until a time limit, and the agent pays in time and tokens. To the best of our knowledge, this paper is the first to measure and repair the return assumption. We collect 91,469 production tool calls and 89,047 public agent trajectories, test how 8 widely used harnesses launch commands, and build Litmus, a catalog of 158 checked command-line invocations, and Tripwire, a benchmark of 25 task pairs that differ only in whether a question guards the requested action. We then propose RECEIPT, which keeps the input open, reads what each process waits for from system calls, and returns this state to an unmodified agent through a model-checked protocol. On Litmus, closed input causes 11.5% of tested invocations to return status 0 without performing the requested action, and 7 of 8 harnesses close input when no terminal is attached. An unanswered question at a plain terminal multiplies a task's token use by 2.9, and the input connection moves an LLM from 7th to 3rd place among 8. Across 5 LLMs, RECEIPT reduces false claims of success by 73.5% and completes all 25 guarded tasks on a second harness. An agent's reliability therefore depends on what its harness lets it observe as well as on its LLM. Agent builders should report what each tool call did, not only how it ended, and benchmark maintainers should fix and report the input connection before they rank LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: RECEIPT通过保持输入打开并检测进程等待状态，修复LLM智能体运维Web服务的返回假设，减少虚假成功73.5%。 LLM智能体通过命令行运维Web基础设施，并依赖一个返回假设，即每次工具调用都会在有界时间内返回，且其请求的操作已完成。 然而，许多命令在执行动作前会先提出一个问题，而智能体的运行环境（harness）要么关闭程序的输入，要么将其保持为一个无人输入的终端。 在输入关闭的情况下，程序可以在未执行请求操作的情况下返回状态0。 在输入打开的情况下，程序会一直等待直到超时，智能体则要付出时间和令牌的代价。 据我们所知，本文是首个测量并修复返回假设的工作。 我们收集了91,469次生产环境工具调用和89,047条公开智能体轨迹，测试了8个广泛使用的运行环境如何启动命令，并构建了Litmus——一个包含158个受检命令行调用的目录，以及Tripwire——一个由25对仅在「是否有问题守护请求操作」上存在差异的任务对构成的基准。 随后我们提出RECEIPT，它保持输入打开，通过系统调用读取每个进程的等待状态，并通过一个经模型检验的协议将该状态返回给未经修改的智能体。 在Litmus上，输入关闭导致11.5%的被测调用在未执行请求操作的情况下返回状态0，且8个运行环境中有7个在未连接终端时会关闭输入。 在普通终端处一个未被回答的问题会使任务的令牌用量增加2.9倍，而输入连接使一个LLM在8个模型中的排名从第7位升至第3位。 在5个LLM上，RECEIPT将虚假成功声明减少73.5%，并在第二个运行环境上完成全部25个受守护任务。 因此，智能体的可靠性不仅取决于其LLM，还取决于其运行环境允许它观察到什么。 智能体开发者应报告每次工具调用做了什么，而不仅仅是它如何结束；基准维护者在给LLM排名之前，应先修复并报告输入连接情况。
